description: This source file contains unit tests for the BasketService class in the application core, specifically testing the TransferBasketAsync method under various scenarios. It uses Xunit for testing and NSubstitute for mocking dependencies.

classes.name: Results<T>
classes.description: A helper class to simulate a sequence of return values for mocked methods.

classes.name: TransferBasket
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for the TransferBasketAsync method of BasketService.

methods.name: InvokesBasketRepositoryFirstOrDefaultAsyncOnceIfAnonymousBasketNotExists
methods.description: Tests that the repository's FirstOrDefaultAsync method is called exactly once when the anonymous basket does not exist during a transfer.

methods.name: TransferAnonymousBasketItemsWhilePreservingExistingUserBasketItems
methods.description: Ensures that anonymous basket items are transferred to the user basket and existing user basket items are preserved correctly.

methods.name: RemovesAnonymousBasketAfterUpdatingUserBasket
methods.description: Verifies that the anonymous basket is deleted after its items are transferred to the user basket.

methods.name: CreatesNewUserBasketIfNotExists
methods.description: Checks that a new user basket is created when the user does not have an existing basket during transfer.
